integrity: Self-contained algebraic and analytic derivation, accompanied by standalone rational checker; no claim of independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform periodic continuous real linear splines, n>=3 and only the L-infinity operator norm. No nonuniform-knot or higher-degree assertion; possible uncatalogued equivalent prior formulae. The computed small-n tests do not prove asymptotics.
title: Parity boundary layers for periodic linear-spline least-squares projection
